name: Dong Fang Offshore Co., Ltd.
summary: Dong Fang Offshore Co., Ltd. provides offshore maritime solutions. It operates various offshore vessels, including small vessels and large cable-laying ships with a total of 18 ships. The company also provides power cable transport, installation, maintenance, and repair; cable burial; pull-in and cable T and T Support; horizontal directional drilling; nearshore export cable pull-in support; telecoms cable EPCI; and on-shore cable logistics and storage services.
